ITEM.PTXT: By pressing the "Audio" panel switch while the audio is being used, the screen changes to the audio mode screen, where the operating status and operation of music sources (AM/FM radio, MD, CD, etc.) and audio adjustments such as sound quality and volume balance can be performed.

Music sources have been enhanced by supporting MP3 (MPEG Audio Layer3)/WMA (Windows Media Audio) and by newly adopting a sound library that allows music CDs to be recorded onto the built-in hard disk.
